newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's AMP wins approval for Beijing office.
newsitem.headline: Australia's AMP wins approval for Beijing office.

text.p: Australia's largest life office, The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP), said on Thursday it had obtained formal approval from the People's Bank of China to open a representative office in Beijing.
AMP said the Beijing representative office marked the first time AMP had established a presence in China.

The office would be used to achieve an active understanding of China, to build valuable relationship with local Chinese regulators and to identify business opportunities and potential joint venture partners, AMP said.

"We believe that the Chinese market has huge potential," said AMP group communications executive Bob Pritchard said in a staetment. "In the long term, AMP's objective is to be part of China's financial services markets," he said.
Pritchard said AMP's Asian strategy was to partner with local business people to develop long term businesses.
He said AMP expected its Beijing office to formally open sometime in the third quarter.
